title: fix(spec): read a stored object_extension row as an objectExtensions entry, and list its refused fieldPatches keys
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8TiB3eA4r9DuUc3kKYE8at5)_

Fixes #29554

Clause-②: no (no accept set moves; the stored pass and the `--stored` listing widen)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:存量 `object_extension` 行现在按 `objectExtensions` 条目走存量转换,`os migrate meta --stored` 会列出 `fieldPatches` 里不可能是字段名的键。
- 为什么改:此前存量通道找不到该类型的集合,原样返回整行,任何转换与拒收形状检测都跳过扩展行,升级前看不到问题。
- 风险与回滚:读取存量扩展行时会多跑已有的 `objectExtensions` 转换(如时间默认值去掉 `Z`);规范行按引用原样返回。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts` 新检测器;`packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts` 的一行映射;`.changeset/29366-field-patches-key-grammar.md` 被改的那句。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/conversions/stored.test.ts src/conversions/refused-shapes.test.ts`,应见 110 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的:确认对 #29366 尚未发布的 changeset 那一句的更正(`check-empty-changeset` 对此按设计报红,只能由人确认)。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts`: `STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS` maps `object_extension` to `objectExtensions`, beside `translation`. A stored extension row is one `objectExtensions` entry, so every conversion that walks that collection now replays over it at each rehydration seam, and the stored pass hands it to the refused-shape detectors.
- `packages/spec/src/conversions/refused-shapes.ts`: one detector, `object-extension-field-patch-key-grammar-refused`, appended last (additive, so spec seat 5's detector lands after it). Its predicate is the refusing door's own: `ObjectExtensionSchema.safeParse` on the extension, keeping each `invalid_key` issue located at `fieldPatches.KEY`. It lists, never rewrites, and closes each reason with the parse's own message.
- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.object-extension-field-patch-key-grammar-refused.ts`: the header and `acceptanceCriteria` said `--stored` does not list such a row and named a manual check. They now say the row is listed, one TODO per refused key at `fieldPatches.KEY`, and left as stored.
- `.changeset/29366-field-patches-key-grammar.md`: the matching sentence in that pending note is corrected the same way (see Acceptance notes).
- `.changeset/29554-stored-object-extension-rows.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/spec`.

## Why

The card's premise holds on `origin/main` `ff827bcf`: `applyConversionsToStoredItem` returned a stored `object_extension` row by reference with 0 notices and 0 TODOs, while the control `object` row with the same `time` default got one `time-default-utc-suffix-dropped` notice.

Measured before choosing the map:

- **Stored type names.** The save door folds the URL segments `object_extension`, `object_extensions` and `objectExtensions` to `object_extension` (`meta-url-data.generated.ts`), so `object_extension` is the one stored spelling. The protocol's singular/plural read fallback (`PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR[t] ?? SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL[t]`) finds no other spelling for it, and `migrateStoredMetadata` reports a row stored under another spelling as `skipped` (`isNonCanonicalStoredType`) before reading its body. So no plural spelling is mapped, and a test pins that both plurals still pass through by reference.
- **The omission is deliberate in the shared maps.** `check:stack-collection-maps` records `objectExtensions` as a deliberate `missing` waiver of the manifest-collection map: extensions merge into their target rather than registering as named items, and `pluralToSingular` feeds registration and the authoring lint. Adding it there would advertise `objectExtensions` as a named-item collection to every reader. The stored-only map exists for exactly this case, so the entry goes there.

## Tests

- `stored.test.ts`: a stored `object_extension` row with a `Z`-suffixed `time` default is wrapped as `objectExtensions[0]`, converted, and noticed at `objectExtensions[0].fields.opens_at.defaultValue`; the input is not mutated. Controls: a canonical extension row passes through by reference; the same body as an `object` row converts exactly as before; `object_extensions` and `objectExtensions` row types pass through by reference.
- `refused-shapes.test.ts`: the registered id list gains the new id last; one TODO per refused key (`Industry`, `annual-revenue`) at `objectExtensions[0].fieldPatches.KEY`, the row unchanged; the listed keys equal the parse's `invalid_key` issues (`Industry`, `Annual Revenue`) and each reason ends with the parse's message; snake_case keys are not listed and parse; a `__c` key (another entry's arm) is not listed by this detector.

<details><summary>Ablations (committed first, restored by blob hash)</summary>

- `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleting `object_extension: 'objectExtensions',` from `stored.ts`: 3 failed / 107 passed (the conversion test and both listing tests), restored, blob `e26e3a1e` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Deleting `objectExtensionFieldPatchKeyGrammar,` from `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES`: 3 failed / 84 passed (the id list and both listing tests), restored, blob `d205cc7d` == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

<details><summary>End-to-end probe through migrateStoredMetadata (scratch test, not committed)</summary>

Built the `@objectstack/objectql...` closure and ran a throwaway copy of the `protocol.stored-migration.test.ts` harness:

- An `object_extension` row with `fieldPatches: { Industry: … }` and nothing else: `skipped`, 1 TODO (`object-extension-field-patch-key-grammar-refused` at `objectExtensions[0].fieldPatches.Industry`). On `ff827bcf` the stored pass returned that row untouched with 0 TODOs, which this pass records as `canonical`.
- The same key plus a `Z`-suffixed `time` default: preview `pending` with the conversion and the TODO both printed under the row; `--apply` reports it `failed` because the save door refuses the key, as for every other refused shape that also converts.
- A packaged extension with only the `Z`-suffixed default on `opens_at__c`: `--apply` reports `rewritten` and the stored body becomes `"12:00"`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Corrected a pending release note.** `.changeset/29366-field-patches-key-grammar.md` (PR #29513, not yet released) said `os migrate meta --stored` does not list such a row and told readers to check by hand. This PR makes that false, so the sentence now says the row is listed. `check-empty-changeset` refuses any change to a changeset this PR did not add and stays red by design for the deliberate-correction class; please confirm the correction.
- The `missing` waiver reason in `scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs` still says there is no singular metadata-type name for `objectExtensions`; ADR-0146 D10 added `object_extension`. The waiver itself stays right (the manifest map should not carry it); only its reason text is dated. Noted, not filed (wording).
- No `protocol.ts` file is touched (freeze until 06:00 UTC on 3 November).

## Verification

Gates at head `91fbde28` (this branch merged with `origin/main` `dbca3ef0`):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 81 derived commands; all run, plus `check:stack-collection-maps`, `check:meta-url-spelling`, the spec `typecheck` and `vitest run src/conversions src/migrations` (28 files, 981 tests).
- `--ran` reconciliation: 81 accounted, 80 run, 1 NOT MEASURED, 0 unrun.
- Every run exits 0 except `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` (exit 1, the correction above).
- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, it needs every package built; CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it).
- `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone; after fetching its pinned fixture commit it exits 0. `check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3 for want of `objectql/dist`; after the closure build it exits 0.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: no generated artifact moved (`check:api-surface`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:docs` exit 0).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.

## Maintainer approval

Warren approved the rewrite of the pending `.changeset/29366-field-patches-key-grammar.md` sentence (option A): 「全部批准」 on the decision card 「六个命名/措辞全部按推荐批准吗？」 in the project thread "Decide pending spec name approvals", 2026-11-03 00:08Z. Recorded on this PR in seat comment 6591818192. That is the person's written confirmation the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class of `check-empty-changeset` asks for; `Check Changeset` stays red by design and is not a required context.
